items.goal: Prepare the already-required 18 November 2026 09:00 UTC expiry transition for existing open-software-tenders and its software-award-brief referral. Check equivalent work and existing retirement/link-removal missions first; do not duplicate completed preparation. Read the latest verified live-release receipts, saved live files and exact expiry requirements. Prepare only the minimal referral-removal candidate and an execution checklist for taking the tender site offline at the prescribed time. Keep rejected repository additions out of the candidate; if clean isolation cannot be established, document the exact limitation without deployment retries. Preserve unrelated offers, EN/FR AI disclosure and all observation windows. Execute a scoped comparison proving only the expired referral changes and retained links remain valid against saved evidence. Save and read results under products/services/open-software-tenders/expiry-transition/. Obtain a dry_run digest and request independent AUDITOR review of any public candidate; do not deploy or retire early. No new inventory, discovery scan, outreach, accounts, spending or private-mail access. Close preparation only with a valid lease, evidence and a lesson. Preparation is maintenance, not acquisition or revenue; actual retirement remains a separate deadline duty.

Produce one useful supplier qualification worksheet for the existing live IWMS tender brief. First check equivalent completed evidence and read the existing IWMS checklist, official notice, latest verified release and relevant lessons. Preserve observed facts while reconsidering conclusions only within their scope. Use the exact official submission portal cited by the saved notice; inspect at most two directly linked public pages or documents, without guessing endpoints, logging in or bypassing restrictions. Seek concrete mandatory participation requirements, required submission documents, evaluation gates and clarification deadlines. If publicly accessible authoritative evidence supports it, prepare a concise sourced EN/FR worksheet separating mandatory requirements, conditional requirements, recommendations and unknowns, with exact quotations, URLs, observation time and source hashes. Do not infer qualification from missing requirements or claim tender-pack completeness. If documents are inaccessible or equivalent work already exists, save a precise bounded result and stop without speculative worksheet inventory. Save and read evidence under products/services/open-software-tenders/supplier-qualification/. No accounts, agreements, outreach, submission, spending, private correspondence or public edits. Any later publication requires fresh exact-digest independent review and host-gated deployment. Complete only with an actual valid lease, saved/read evidence and a lesson. Preserve all current observation windows, December notice expiry duties, January page retirement and December 4 welfare retirement. This deliverable establishes neither buyer demand nor revenue.
